t: Master Computer: Amdahl Speedup Desk — Simple
name: Master Computer: Amdahl Speedup Desk — Simple
title: Master Computer: Amdahl Speedup Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Parallelism has a law: speedup = 1/((1−p) + p/s). The desk computes the speedup for any parallel fraction and core count — the number that kills 'just add cores' fantasies with arithmetic.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Speedup: 90% parallel on 16 cores = 6.40 speedup. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

signature_version: Signature version: the integration Amdahl desk — the chapter's all-in-one target as the scaling target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.

standards: Full-file record, never a stub

real_world_basis: Throughput budgeting is the real basis of processor sizing.
signature_version: Signature version: the integration throughput desk — the chapter's target as the throughput target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.

t: Master Computer: Heterogeneous Scheduler — Simple
name: Master Computer: Heterogeneous Scheduler — Simple
title: Master Computer: Heterogeneous Scheduler — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators each win some workloads: the scheduler maps tasks to engines by measured throughput, with the mapping recomputed per workload mix. Heterogeneity is managed, not hoped.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Mixed workload: 70% GPU-friendly at 10x, 30% CPU = 2.70 speedup. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Master Computer (All in One): Integration and Manifestation
real_world_basis: Measured-mapping scheduling is the real practice of heterogeneous computing.
signature_version: Signature version: the integration scheduler — the chapter's target as the utilization target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the benchmarks must be your workloads — vendor benchmarks flatter.
math_note: Mixed workload: 70% GPU-friendly at 10x, 30% CPU: 2.70 speedup [verified]; Binary entropy of a 70/30 mix: 0.8813 bits [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a scheduler tuned to the wrong workload.
how_it_works: Benchmark each engine per task class, assign tasks to the winner, and verify the end-to-end time. The demo schedules a mixed AI/HPC mix.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub

real_world_basis: Scorecard-driven integration is real; the 'master' framing is the concept layer.

how_it_works: Assemble the real integration techniques, mark the gap, and publish the boundary. The concept is integration with receipts. The demo publishes the scorecard.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time
